div.head: II Cn 51
div.ab: Gif hwa sibleger gewyrce, gebete þæt be sibbe mæðe, swa be were swa be wite swa be ealre æhte:
Be siblegere. Gyf hwa sibleger gewyrce, gebete þæt be sibbe mæðe, swa be were swa be wite swa be ealra æhta:
Gif hwa sibleger gewirce, gebete þæt be sibbe mæðe, swa be w[er]e swa be wite swa be ealra ehte:
Si quis cum pertinente sua iaceat, emendet hoc secundum cognationis modum, sic wéra sic wita sic omni pecunia:
[51] Si quis cum cognata concumbit, emendet illud iuxta modum cognacionis, siue per redempcionem siue per forisfacturam siue per totam substanciam:
Be siblegere. Gyf hwa sibleger gewyrce, gebete þæt be sibbe mæðe, swa be were swa be wite swa be ealra æhta.
Gif hwa sibleger gewyrce, gebete þæt be sibbe mæðe, swa be were swa be wite swa be ealre æhte.
(Von Blutschande. B) Wenn einer Blutschande verübt, büsse er das nach dem Grade der Verwandtschaft: entweder durch [sein] Wergeld oder durch Strafgeld oder durch [seinen] ganzen Besitz.
(Of incest. B) If anyone commits incest, let him make amends according to the degree of kinship: either by [his] wergild or by a fine or by [his] whole property.

Concerning incest. If anyone commits incest, he shall make amends according to the degree of relationship [between them], either by the payment of wergeld or of a fine, or by the forfeiture of all his possessions.
If anyone commits incest, he is to pay compensation according to the degree of the relationship, whether by wergild or by fine or by all his possessions.
If anyone commits incest, the penalty shall be assessed according to the degree of kinship, either by the payment of wergild, a fine, or by the confiscation of all of the offender’s property.
